DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35206-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35206-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 散歩の案内図をご覧ですね。今日はどのくらい歩くご予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35206-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're looking at the walking map. How long are you planning to walk today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35206-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35206-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 暗くなる前に帰りたいので、十五分ほどにしたいです。池を見ながら歩ける道はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35206-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 暗くなる前に十五分程度で池を見て歩きたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35206-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to return before dark, so about fifteen minutes. Is there a path where I can walk while looking at the pond?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35206-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to walk and see the pond for about fifteen minutes before dark. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35206-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35206-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 池の東側は工事で通れません。西側の道へ行く方法はありますが、今いる入口へ戻ると少し長くなります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35206-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: The east side of the pond is closed for construction. There is a way to reach the west-side path, but returning to this entrance would make it a little longer.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35206-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35206-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: それなら池まで行かなくてもいいです。近くで座って水面を見られる場所はありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35206-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 池まで行くのをやめ近くで座って水面を見られる場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35206-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Then I don't need to go all the way to the pond. Is there somewhere nearby to sit and look at the water?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35206-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give up going to the pond and ask for a nearby place to sit and see the water. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35206-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35206-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この展望広場からなら池が見えます。ここから舗装路で行けて、途中に一か所ゆるい坂があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35206-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can see the pond from this viewing plaza. You can reach it along a paved path from here, with one gentle slope on the way.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35206-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35206-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ゆるい坂なら歩けます。広場に着いて疲れたら、座って休めますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35206-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: ゆるい坂は歩けると伝え広場で座れるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35206-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can manage a gentle slope. If I get tired when I reach the plaza, can I sit and rest?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35206-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you can walk a gentle slope and ask whether you can sit at the plaza. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35206-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35206-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ベンチがあります。戻るときは同じ舗装路です。工事の柵の方へ下りず、坂を戻ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35206-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: There are benches. Return by the same paved path. Don't go down toward the construction fence; return along the slope you came along.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35206-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35206-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 柵の方へは行かず、来た坂を戻ります。帰る入口は、この案内図の北入口ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35206-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 工事側に進まず同じ坂を戻ると確認し北入口を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35206-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I won't go toward the fence; I'll return along the same slope. The entrance to leave by is this north entrance on the map, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35206-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm you will not head toward construction and will return along the same slope, and check the north entrance. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35206-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35206-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、北入口です。休憩が長くなっても暗くなる前に戻れるよう、時刻を見ておくとよいでしょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35206-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, the north entrance. It would be good to watch the time so you can return before dark even if your break runs longer.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35206-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35206-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 広場で五分だけ休んで戻ります。今の時刻を確認して、長居しないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35206-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 広場の休憩を五分にして現在時刻を確認し長居しないと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35206-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll rest for only five minutes at the plaza and come back. I'll check the current time and avoid staying too long.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35206-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to limit the plaza rest to five minutes, check the current time, and avoid lingering. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35206-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35206-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞ無理のない範囲でお楽しみください。お帰りも北入口を目印に。では、いってらっしゃい。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35206-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please enjoy it without overexerting yourself. Use the north entrance as your landmark on the way back too. Have a pleasant walk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 目的地までのご相談ですね。会場から届いた案内はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: You'd like directions to your destination. Do you have information sent by the venue?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 研修の案内があります。本館ではなく別館へ行くのですが、降りる駅は同じでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 別館会場への案内を示し本館と同じ降車駅か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have the training information. I'm going to the annex rather than the main building; is the station to get off at the same?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Show the annex venue information and ask whether to get off at the same station as for the main building. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この案内では別館にも同じ最寄り駅が書かれています。ただ、駅からの道順が別に載っていますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: This information gives the same nearest station for the annex too. However, the directions from the station are listed separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 最寄り駅までの列車経路を先に確認したいです。この地図の駅名を見てもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 地図の駅名を示し列車経路の確認を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'd like to check the train route to the nearest station first. Could you look at the station name on this map?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the station name on the map and ask to check the train route. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 拝見します。こちらの経路案内で検索しましょう。検索結果には乗り換えと行き先表示も出ています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let me see. Let's search using this route planner. The results also show transfers and the destination displays.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 乗り換えるときは、駅名だけでなく列車の行き先表示も確認するのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 乗換で行き先表示も確認すべきと復唱する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: So when changing trains, I should check the train's destination display as well as the station name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Repeat that you should also check the destination display when transferring. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。ホームや時刻はその日の案内で確かめてください。駅を出た後は、別館用の地図をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. Check platforms and times using that day's information. After leaving the station, look at the annex map.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 別館用には北側の出口と書いてあります。降車駅の案内でその出口を探し、地図と合わせればよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 別館地図の北側出口を駅表示と照合する順序を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: The annex information says to use the north exit. Should I find that exit on the arrival station's signs, then match it with the map?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask about the sequence of matching the annex map's north exit with station signs. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その順で確認してください。地図で位置がわからなければ、会場の連絡先へ問い合わせることもできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check in that order. If you cannot locate yourself on the map, you can also inquire using the venue's contact details.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 列車は検索結果と当日の表示で確認し、降りたら北側出口から別館用の地図を使います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 検索と当日表示で乗車し北側出口から別館地図を使うと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll check the train using the search results and that day's signs, then use the annex map from the north exit after getting off.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will use the search and same-day signs to board and the annex map from the north exit. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 本館用の地図と取り違えないようお持ちください。どうぞお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please bring the map without confusing it with the main-building map. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 提出先の指定を確認しながらご案内します。依頼の紙はお持ちでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: I'll guide you while checking the requirements of the receiving organization. Do you have their request sheet?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 会社からこの紙を渡されました。証明書は私一人分でよいと書いてありますが、省略する項目がわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 会社の一人分指定を示し省略項目が不明と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: My company gave me this sheet. It says a certificate for me alone is enough, but I don't know which details to omit.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Show the company's instruction for one person and say you do not know what details to omit. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご本人分という指定と、記載項目の指定は別ですね。まず、必要と書かれた項目を拾いましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Specifying that it is for you alone and specifying the details to include are separate things. First, let's pick out the items marked as required.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この二つが必要と書かれています。申請用紙では似た名前の欄があり、どちらに当たるか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 必要二項目と似た申請欄の対応を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: It says these two are needed. The application has fields with similar names, and I'm unsure which corresponds to them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask about matching the two required items with similarly named application fields. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その欄の説明を一緒に読みます。依頼書と意味が一致するか、提出先にも確認できるようにしましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's read the explanations for those fields together. Let's also make it possible to check with the receiving organization whether the meanings match the request.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 似ているだけで選ぶのは避けたいです。会社に聞くため、欄の正式な名前をメモしてよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 似た名前で選ばず正式欄名をメモして会社に聞くと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I don't want to choose just because the names are similar. May I note the official field names so I can ask my company?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will not choose based on similar names and will note the official field names to ask your company. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。こちらの案内にも記載項目の説明があります。持ち帰って照合していただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. This guide also explains the details that can be included. You can take it home and compare them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 会社が必要な項目を確認できるまで、証明書を発行しないで待つことにします。申請用紙も持ち帰れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 項目確認まで発行を保留し申請用紙持ち帰りを求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll hold off having the certificate issued until I can confirm the details my company needs. Can I take the application form home too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Hold off on issuance until the details are confirmed and ask to take the application form home. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: どうぞ。必要な項目が確定したら、ご本人分という指定も含めて窓口へお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please do. Once the required details are settled, tell the counter, including the instruction that it is for you alone.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 依頼書と欄の説明を会社に見せます。一人分の範囲と必要項目が確定してから申請します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 依頼書と欄説明を会社に示し範囲と項目確定後に申請すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll show my company the request and field explanations. I'll apply after the scope of one person's information and required details are settled.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to show the request and field explanations to your company and apply after the scope and details are confirmed. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その内容を確認してからお越しください。今日はお気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please return after confirming that information. Take care on your way home today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご来院の理由を伺います。今、立っているのはつらくありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: May I ask why you have come to the clinic? Is standing right now difficult?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 座っていると落ち着きますが、立ち上がるとふらつきます。受付へ来る途中も一度止まりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 座ると落ち着き立つとふらつく及び途中停止を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I feel settled when sitting, but unsteady when I stand up. I also stopped once on my way to reception.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that sitting settles you, standing causes unsteadiness, and you stopped along the way. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらに座ってください。いつから、どんな場面で起きているか教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please sit here. Could you tell me when it began and in what situations it happens?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今朝、ベッドから起きたときに始まりました。ずっと続くのではなく、立つときに感じます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 今朝起床時発症し持続でなく立位時に感じると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: It started this morning when I got out of bed. It isn't continuous; I feel it when standing up.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say it started on getting up this morning and occurs on standing rather than continuously. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その違いを担当へ伝えます。今の症状について、ほかに気になることはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll tell the staff member responsible about that distinction. Is there anything else concerning you about your current symptoms?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 吐いたりはしていません。「症状が続く」というのは、座っていてもずっと感じることですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 嘔吐なしと伝え続く症状という表現を聞き返す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I haven't vomited. When you say “symptoms continue,” do you mean feeling them all the time even while sitting?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you have not vomited and ask what “continuing symptoms” means. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そういう場合も含めて、いつ感じるかを確認しています。お客様は立つときに感じるということですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: We are checking when you feel them, including situations like that. In your case, you feel them when standing up, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。診察室へ呼ばれたとき、急いで立たずにスタッフへ声をかけてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 立つときの症状と確認し呼ばれたら先にスタッフへ声かけできるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. When I'm called to the consultation room, may I speak to a staff member instead of standing up in a hurry?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm symptoms occur on standing and ask whether you can speak to staff first when called. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: もちろんです。無理に立たず、必要なら移動をお手伝いします。変化があれば待っている間も知らせてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Of course. Don't force yourself to stand; we can help you move if needed. Tell us about any changes while you are waiting too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 座って待ちます。呼ばれたら声をかけ、ふらつきが変わったときもその場で伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 座位待機と呼出時声かけ及び変化時報告を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll wait sitting down. When called, I'll speak to staff, and if the unsteadiness changes, I'll tell them there and then too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will wait seated, speak to staff when called, and report any changes. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: わかりました。担当へお話を引き継ぎます。では、また後ほど。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll pass your information to the staff member responsible. See you shortly.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 不審な連絡についてですね。届いた画面を見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is about suspicious contact. Could you show me the screen you received?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 荷物の再配達というメッセージです。心当たりがないのに、リンクを開いてしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 心当たりのない再配達メッセージのリンクを開いたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: It's a message about parcel redelivery. I opened the link even though I wasn't expecting anything.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain you opened a link in an unexpected redelivery message. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 開いた後、名前やカード情報を入力したり、何かを入れたりしましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: After opening it, did you enter your name or card details, or install anything?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 入力はしていません。画面に支払いの欄が出たので閉じました。アプリも入れていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 情報入力もアプリ導入もなく支払い画面を閉じたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I didn't enter anything. A payment section appeared, so I closed the screen. I haven't installed an app either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you entered no information, installed no app, and closed the payment screen. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 操作した範囲を記録しましょう。元のメッセージと送信元、届いた時刻は残っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's record what you did. Do you still have the original message, sender, and time received?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: メッセージは残っています。ただ、開いた画面は閉じてしまい、写真がありません。もう一度開くべきですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 画面写真がなく記録のため再度開くべきか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I still have the message. But I closed the page I opened and have no photo. Should I open it again?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether to reopen it for the record because you have no screen photo. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 記録のために再び開く必要はありません。覚えている内容を、元のメッセージと分けて説明してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: There is no need to open it again to make a record. Explain what you remember separately from the original message.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 支払い欄があったことと、情報を入れなかったことをメモします。配送会社への確認は、別に調べた連絡先を使うほうがよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未入力と支払い欄を記録し配送会社確認に別の連絡先を使うか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll note that there was a payment field and that I entered no information. For checking with the delivery company, would it be better to use contact details found separately?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Record the payment field and lack of input, and ask about using separate contact details to check with the delivery company. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのメッセージのリンクだけを頼りにせず、正規の窓口を確認してください。ここでも詳しい状況を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Don't rely only on the link in that message; check the official contact point. We'll hear more details here too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 元のメッセージを保存し、自分が開いた範囲をメモします。リンクを再度開かず、相談を続けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 元の記録と操作メモを保存しリンク再訪せず相談を継続すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll save the original message and note how far I went after opening it. I'll continue seeking advice without reopening the link.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will save the original record and notes of your actions and continue consulting without revisiting the link. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。相談担当へおつなぎします。こちらでの受付は以上です。それでは失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll connect you to the consultation staff. That completes reception here. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 発送予定のお荷物ですね。中には何が入っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is the parcel you plan to send. What's inside?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 未使用のシャンプーです。ふたは閉めましたが、箱を横にすると漏れないか心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 未使用シャンプーのふたを閉めたが横倒し漏れが心配と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Unused shampoo. I've closed the cap, but I'm worried it might leak if the box is laid on its side.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you closed the unused shampoo's cap but are worried about leakage if laid sideways. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まず商品の内容と発送方法の条件を確認します。漏れを防ぐ包装も必要ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: First we'll check the product contents and shipping-method conditions. Packaging to prevent leakage is necessary too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 商品名と成分表示はこの容器にあります。今の包装で預けられるか、先に確認してほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 商品成分表示を示し現在包装で預けられるか確認依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: The product name and ingredients are on this container. I'd like you to check first whether I can hand it over in the current packaging.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the product ingredients label and ask to check whether the current packaging can be accepted. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 表示を拝見します。箱の中で容器が動くようなので、このまま引受可能とはまだご案内できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll look at the label. The container seems to move in the box, so I cannot yet say we can accept it as it is.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 容器を固定し、万一漏れても外へ出ないように包み直したいです。包装の案内はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 固定と漏れ対策をして包み直すため包装案内を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'd like to secure the container and rewrap it so any leakage won't escape outside. Do you have packaging guidance?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for packaging guidance to secure it and rewrap it with leakage protection. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この案内で液体の包装を確認できます。ただ、包装だけで品物の発送条件が決まるわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can check liquid packaging in this guide. However, packaging alone does not determine the conditions for shipping the item.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 包装と品物の条件を別々に確認するのですね。宛先は国内ですが、利用する方法もここで相談できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 包装と品物条件を区別し国内発送方法の相談を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: So packaging and product conditions are checked separately. The destination is domestic; can I also discuss which service to use here?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish packaging and product conditions and ask for advice on domestic shipping methods. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、内容と宛先を確認して選びましょう。今日は包み直してから、再度お持ちいただく形でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, let's choose after checking the contents and destination. Is it all right to rewrap it today and then bring it back?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は発送せずに持ち帰ります。包装を直して、商品表示と宛先をそろえて再度相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 当日発送せず包装修正後に表示と宛先をそろえて相談すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't send it today; I'll take it home. I'll fix the packaging and return for advice with the product label and destination details ready.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide not to ship today and to return with the label and destination after fixing the packaging. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。引受条件を確認してから進めましょう。お気をつけてお持ち帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Let's proceed after checking the acceptance conditions. Take care carrying it home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 振込のお手続きですね。請求書と振込先の情報はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You'd like to make a transfer. Do you have the invoice and recipient account information?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: こちらです。請求額から手数料を引いて送るつもりでしたが、それでよいか不安です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 請求額から手数料を差し引く予定が適切か不安と述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Here they are. I was going to deduct the transfer fee from the invoiced amount, but I'm unsure whether that is right.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you are unsure whether deducting the fee from the invoiced amount is appropriate. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 銀行では請求先との取り決めを判断できません。請求額と振込手数料を分けて確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: The bank cannot judge your agreement with the invoicing party. Let's check the invoiced amount and transfer fee separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 請求書に手数料をどちらが負担するか書かれていません。先方へ聞いてから金額を決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 負担指定がないため先方確認後に送金額を決めると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: The invoice doesn't say which side pays the fee. I'll decide the amount after asking them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you will decide the transfer amount after checking with the other party because the fee payer is not specified. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: それが確実です。振込先の銀行名、支店、口座番号、名義も先に照合できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: That is the surest way. You can also check the recipient bank, branch, account number, and account holder first.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 四つの情報はこの請求書にあります。自分のメモと一字ずつ比べたいので、少し時間をください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 口座四情報をメモと比較する時間を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: The four details are on this invoice. I'd like to compare them character by character with my notes, so please give me a little time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for time to compare the four account details with your notes. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: どうぞ。食い違いがあれば確定せずご相談ください。費用については、この案内で方法別に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Of course. If anything differs, don't finalize it; consult us. We'll check costs by method using this guide.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 窓口と端末では費用が違う場合があるのですね。今回使う方法の手数料を、送金前に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 方法別費用を理解し利用方法の手数料を送金前に確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: So costs may differ between the counter and terminal. I'd like to confirm the fee for the method I'll use before transferring.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show understanding of costs by method and say you want to check your method's fee before transferring. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご利用方法と条件を確認してご案内します。先方の回答と銀行の費用を見てからお決めください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll check your method and conditions and explain. Decide after seeing the other party's reply and the bank's costs.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は送金を確定しません。先方へ負担を聞き、口座情報と利用方法の費用を確認してから進めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 当日確定せず負担口座費用確認後に進めると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't finalize a transfer today. I'll ask who pays, check the account information and the costs for my chosen method, then proceed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide not to finalize today and to proceed after checking fee responsibility, the account, and costs. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。確認後にまたご相談ください。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Consult us again after checking. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 商品をお入れする袋は、お持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you brought a bag for your purchases?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 小さい袋を持っています。この箱まで入るか試したいので、袋を買うかは少し待ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 持参小袋に箱が入るか試すまで袋購入を待ってほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have a small bag. I'd like to see whether this box fits too, so please wait a moment before I decide whether to buy a bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask them to hold off on buying a bag until you try whether the box fits in your small bag. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 承知しました。袋を広げて大きさを確認していただけます。箱は無理に押し込まないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Certainly. You can open your bag and check its size. Don't force the box into it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 入りませんでした。箱用に袋を一枚ください。持参した袋には残りを入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 箱が入らず一枚追加し残りは持参袋に入れると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: It didn't fit. Please give me one bag for the box. I'll put the rest in the bag I brought.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say the box did not fit, ask for one extra bag, and put the rest in your own bag. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 袋一枚を追加します。合計をご覧になってから、お支払い方法をお選びください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll add one bag. Check the total, then choose your payment method.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 財布の現金が足りません。この電子マネーが使えるか、表示で確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 現金不足のため電子マネー対応表示の確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I don't have enough cash in my wallet. Can we check the display to see whether this electronic money is accepted?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to check the display for electronic-money support because you have insufficient cash. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この場面の対応一覧はこちらです。お持ちの種類と一致するか、先に確かめましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Here is the list of types accepted in this situation. Let's first check whether yours matches.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一覧にありますが、残高が足りないかもしれません。支払いを始める前に、自分のアプリで確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 対応種類一致だが残高不安のため操作前に自分で確認すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: It's on the list, but my balance may not be enough. I'll check in my own app before starting payment.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say the type is supported but you will check the balance yourself before operating because you are unsure it is enough. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、確認してからお知らせください。不足時の扱いも、レジの案内で確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, let me know after checking. We'll also check the register guidance for what happens if the balance is insufficient.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 残高が合計より多いと確認できました。この電子マネーで払い、箱は追加の袋へ入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 十分な残高を報告し電子マネー支払いと箱用追加袋を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've confirmed my balance is more than the total. I'll pay with this electronic money and put the box in the extra bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Report sufficient balance and choose electronic-money payment and an extra bag for the box. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。端末の表示をご覧ください。お買い物ありがとうございました。またお越しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please watch the terminal display. Thank you for shopping with us. Come again.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 散歩のご相談でしょうか。雨の後なので、掲示もご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like advice about walking? It has rained, so please check the notices too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 長く歩くと疲れるので、今日は短い往復にしたいです。土の道は避けられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 疲れやすいため短い往復で土道を避ける経路を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I get tired if I walk a long way, so I'd like a short out-and-back walk today. Can I avoid dirt paths?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for a short out-and-back route avoiding dirt paths because you tire easily. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この案内図では入口から橋の手前まで舗装されています。橋を渡ると土の道に続きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: This map shows pavement from the entrance to just before the bridge. After crossing the bridge, it continues as a dirt path.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 橋を渡らずに戻ることにします。途中に通行できない場所がないか、掲示を見てもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 橋で折り返すと決め途中の通行状況掲示の確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll turn back without crossing the bridge. Could you check the notice for any impassable spots along the way?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Decide to turn back at the bridge and ask them to check notices about conditions on the way. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この場面の掲示では奥の土の道が利用を控える区間です。舗装部分にも濡れた箇所はあるので注意してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: The notice for this situation says to avoid using the dirt path farther in. Some paved spots are wet too, so be careful.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 舗装なら必ず乾いているとは限らないのですね。歩きにくければ、橋まで行かずに戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 舗装も濡れると理解し歩きにくければ早めに戻ると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: So pavement isn't always dry. If it's difficult to walk, I'll turn back before reaching the bridge.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Acknowledge that pavement can also be wet and say you will turn back early if walking is difficult. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、距離よりご自分の状態を優先してください。戻るときは、来た舗装道をそのまま引き返せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, prioritize how you feel rather than distance. To return, you can retrace the same paved path you came along.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 入口が二つあるようですが、今いる受付の方へ戻る目印はどれですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 二入口のうち現在受付へ戻る目印を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: There seem to be two entrances. Which landmark brings me back toward the reception where we are now?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for a landmark returning to the current reception among the two entrances. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この案内図の受付マークです。分かれ道で受付の表示を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: It's the reception symbol on this map. Check the reception signs at the fork.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 橋の手前までを上限にし、濡れた道が歩きにくければ早めに戻ります。帰りは受付表示を見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 橋手前を上限に早期折返しと受付表示による帰路を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll go no farther than just before the bridge and turn back early if the wet path is hard to walk. On the return I'll watch the reception signs.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide on just before the bridge as the limit, an early return if needed, and reception signs for the way back. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 無理のない範囲でお楽しみください。では、お気をつけていってらっしゃい。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35207-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Enjoy it without overexerting yourself. Take care on your walk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 遅れの案内でお困りですか。お持ちの切符を見ながらお話を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having trouble with the delay information? I'll listen while looking at your ticket.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この列車から先で乗り換える予定です。遅れたら、予約した列車に間に合わないかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 遅延で予約した乗継列車に間に合わない可能性を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm planning to transfer farther along from this train. If it is late, I may miss the train I reserved.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say the delay may prevent you from making your reserved connection. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 乗り換える列車の予約もお持ちですか。接続について出ている案内と合わせて確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you also have the reservation for the connecting train? I'll check it together with the connection information available.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 予約はこちらです。乗り換えの時間は八分だけなので、別の列車に変えられるか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 予約を示し八分の乗継時間のため別便への変更を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here is the reservation. There are only eight minutes to transfer, so I'd like to know whether I can change to another train.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the reservation and say you want to check changing trains because the connection is only eight minutes. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この予約の変更については、切符の種類も含めて窓口で確認しましょう。まだ乗車前ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check at the counter about changing this reservation, including the ticket type. You haven't boarded yet, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、まだ乗っていません。変更を申し込む前に、追加料金が必要か聞けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 乗車前であると答え変更申込前に追加料金を聞けるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: That's right, I haven't boarded. Can I ask whether there is an extra charge before requesting a change?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you have not boarded and ask whether you can check additional charges before applying to change. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、変更先と切符の条件を確認してから費用を案内します。変更ができるとは、今ここでは断定できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, we'll check the new train and ticket conditions before explaining costs. I cannot say for certain here that a change is possible.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 確認してから決めます。発車の案内が出ても、相談が終わるまでこの列車には乗らない方がよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 条件確認後に判断すると伝え相談完了まで乗車を待つべきか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll decide after checking. Even if departure is announced, should I avoid boarding this train until the consultation is finished?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will decide after checking conditions and ask whether to wait to board until the consultation is complete. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お乗りになる前に、窓口で希望をお伝えください。発車が迫っているので、こちらへすぐご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Before boarding, tell the counter what you want. Departure is approaching, so I'll take you there right away.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 切符と予約を持って窓口へ行き、接続に間に合うかと変更の可否、費用を聞いてから決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 切符と予約を窓口へ持参し接続と変更可否と費用を確認して決めると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll take the ticket and reservation to the counter and decide after asking whether I can make the connection, whether a change is possible, and the cost.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will bring the ticket and reservation to the counter and decide after checking the connection, change eligibility, and costs. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 窓口はこの先です。お急ぎでも足元にお気をつけください。それでは、私はここで失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: The counter is just ahead. Even in a hurry, watch your step. I'll leave you here. Goodbye.
